description:
Rustdoc examples change through tautological-example removal, example-policy decisions and the source-comment sweep. The final corpus is measured once those edits land, by the same method as the pre-removal baseline.

## Background

The pre-removal audit and its census script are linked to the epic in `dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A census by the same method as the pre-removal baseline (`dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/fa787f85-example-census.py`) records example-heading count, per-crate example counts, doctest count and doctest execution time on the final corpus.
- [hard] REQ-02: The record compares these figures with the pre-removal baseline and states the measurement protocol (toolchain, features, build-cache state and host load).
- [hard] REQ-03: No example in the final corpus demonstrates only an accessor, constant, simple constructor or direct mapping, verified by classifying every example added or changed since the baseline.
- [hard] REQ-04: Retained examples compile and pass in the Rust CI gate's Rustdoc and doctest steps.
title: Record the final Rustdoc example census and doctest timing
